Generates a PDF report from testnet logs and CSV data for repair, FEC, and peer analysis.

# Purpose
This script generates a PDF report from Firedancer testnet log files and CSV data that are produced by the `shredcap` tile. It reads execution logs and repair data, extracts key timeline markers such as `snapshot_slot`, `first_turbine`, and `last_executed`, and then builds a report with text output and plots. The report covers slot repair timing, turbine and repair shred behavior, peer round-trip time statistics, repair efficiency, FEC completion timing, and detailed slot-level repair views. The main output is `report.pdf`, which is written in the current directory.

The file acts as a command-line analysis tool, not as a library module. It includes helper functions for log parsing, CSV loading, data filtering, statistical summaries, and plot generation with `matplotlib` and `seaborn`. It also supports automatic discovery of the most recent log file and CSV folder when no arguments are given, and it accepts the `--turbine` flag to include slots at and after the first turbine slot in the slot processing analysis.
